traits.summary: Very short, casual texts, usually one line. Relaxed and jokey with friends, still casual but more careful with clients. Rarely writes full sentences.
traits.language_mix: English mixed with Kannada words in Latin script (~35% Kannada), e.g. 'sari da', 'bartini', 'gottilla maga'.
traits.emoji_habits: Uses 😂 for anything funny and 👍 to confirm, usually one emoji at the end, never more than two.
traits.punctuation_and_casing: Almost always lowercase, no full stops, uses '..' when trailing off and '??' for questions.
avoid: formal greetings like 'Dear' or 'Hope you are well'
